_note: woo-request-corpus-collection (rows 19.1 to 19.4 and 19.18). The corpus of a Woo request is a record on the Woo case (decision D1): a search plan recorded before collection, the configuration a next request starts from, every exclusion with its reason, and every search as a query someone else can run again. A plan without recordedAt is a draft and counts as no plan.

wooSearchPlan.title: Woo search plan
wooSearchPlan.description: Whose files and which systems are searched for a Woo request, over which period and with which terms. Recorded before collection starts. A plan without a recorded date is a draft and counts as no plan.

case.title: Case
case.description: The Woo request case this plan belongs to. One plan per case.

custodians.title: Custodians
custodians.description: The people or functions whose files are searched.

name.title: Name
name.description: The person or function whose files are searched, as the plan names them.

userId.title: Nextcloud user
userId.description: Their Nextcloud user, when they have one.

systems.title: Systems
systems.description: The sources to search, by the ids the case's source list names: files, cases or microsoft365.

recordedBy.title: Recorded by
recordedBy.description: The user who recorded the plan.

recordedAt.title: Recorded at
recordedAt.description: When the plan was recorded. Empty for a draft.

wooRequestConfiguration.title: Woo request configuration
wooRequestConfiguration.description: What a new Woo request can start from: the custodians, systems and terms of an earlier request, without its period. Other changes may add keys; every key present is copied.

case.title: Case
case.description: The Woo request case this configuration belongs to.

custodians.title: Custodians
custodians.description: The people or functions whose files are searched.

name.title: Name
name.description: The person or function whose files are searched, as the plan names them.

userId.title: Nextcloud user
userId.description: Their Nextcloud user, when they have one.

systems.title: Systems
systems.description: The sources to search, by the ids the case's source list names: files, cases or microsoft365.

copiedFrom.title: Copied from
copiedFrom.description: The earlier Woo case or named template this configuration was copied from.

wooExclusion.title: Woo exclusion
wooExclusion.description: A candidate document set aside before review, with the reason, so what the reviewer saw reconciles with what arrived.

case.title: Case
case.description: The Woo request case this belongs to.

documentRef.title: Document
documentRef.description: The document on the case that was set aside, when it was on the case.

source.title: Source
source.description: The source the candidate came from, when it never reached the case.

location.title: Location
location.description: Where the candidate sat in its source.

sha256.title: SHA-256
sha256.description: The hash of the candidate's content, when it was read.

duplicateOf.title: Duplicate of
duplicateOf.description: The document on the case this candidate duplicates.

custodian.title: Custodian
custodian.description: The plan custodian the candidate belongs to.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the candidate was set aside.

note.title: Note
note.description: What the handler wrote about it.

excludedBy.title: Excluded by
excludedBy.description: The user who set it aside, or the add that recorded it.

wooCollectionQuery.title: Woo collection query
wooCollectionQuery.description: A search run from a Woo case, stored so anyone who may read the case can run it again and see what is new.

case.title: Case
case.description: The Woo request case this belongs to.

source.title: Source
source.description: The source searched: files, cases or microsoft365.

terms.title: Search terms
terms.description: The terms the search ran with.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Any further filters the search ran with.

runBy.title: Run by
runBy.description: The user who ran the search.

resultKeys.title: Result keys
resultKeys.description: A stable key per row the search returned: a file id, an item id or an object uuid.

wooStartFrom.title: Started from
wooStartFrom.description: The earlier Woo request this request started from. Its custodians, systems and terms are copied into this request's draft search plan when the case is created.
